SELECT pos.CDATE, pos.PROD_ID, pos.CCY, sum(nvl(pos.BALANCE_QTY,0)) BALANCE_QTY, sum(nvl(pos.BALANCE_AMT,0)) BALANCE_AMT, (case when pos.BUY_PLACE='710000' then '000158' when pos.BUY_PLACE='810000' then '000344' when pos.BUY_PLACE='820000' then '000446' else pos.BUY_PLACE end) as BUY_PLACE , (case when pos.BUY_PLACE in ('710000','810000','820000') then 'C0601' else pos.CUSTOMER_TYPE2 end) as CUSTOMER_TYPE2 FROM CHB_PRD_POSITION pos left join chb_prd_baseinfo info on info.prod_id = pos.prod_id and info.status != 'D' and info.fprod_id is null left join chb_prd_baseinfo finfo on finfo.prod_id = pos.prod_id and finfo.status != 'D' and info.fprod_id is not null where 1=1
select #{sub.prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},to_char(#{sub.vdate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-mm-dd') from dual
group by pos.CDATE,pos.PROD_ID,pos.CCY,pos.BUY_PLACE,pos.CUSTOMER_TYPE2

SELECT to_date(pos.DEALDATE ,'yyyyMMdd') CDATE, pos.FINPROD_ID PROD_ID, pos.CCY, sum(nvl(pos.PRINQTY,0)) BALANCE_QTY, sum(nvl(pos.DEALAMT,0)) BALANCE_AMT, pos.BUY_PLACE, pos.CUSTOMER_TYPE2 FROM P_INTERF_PRO_CUSTOM_DEAL pos where 1=1 and pos.DEALTYPE='1' and (pos.BUY_PLACE not in('210200','330200','350200','370200','440300') or pos.BUY_PLACE is null)
select #{sub.prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},to_char(#{sub.vdate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyyMMdd') from dual
group by pos.DEALDATE, pos.FINPROD_ID, pos.CCY, pos.BUY_PLACE, pos.CUSTOMER_TYPE2

select info.PROD_ID,sub.REGIST_SEQNO, sub.PBC_PROD_ID, sub.BUY_PLACE, sub.CUSTOMER_TYPE1, sub.CCY, sub.INIT_RAISING_AMTSUM, sub.INIT_RAISING_AMTSUMCNY, sub.INIT_RAISING_QTY, sub.SEND_STATUS,sub.STATUS,info.RAISE_ENDDATE from PBC_COL_INIT_PROD_RAISING_SUB sub left join () info on info.PBC_PROD_ID=sub.PBC_PROD_ID where sub.SEND_STATUS in ('02','03') and info.prod_id = #{dto.prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
